suggestions.msg: No entry for editor swap/backup files (e.g. `*.swp`, `*~`), which can leak content during crashes.
suggestions.suggestion: Add `*.swp` and `*~` to cover vim/emacs crash recovery files.

suggestions.msg: The manual verification command uses `echo 'shared-memory/logs/' >> .gitignore`, which appends to `.gitignore` instead of simply reading it, risking accidental corruption of the file during verification.
suggestions.suggestion: Change to a read-only check: `grep -q 'shared-memory/logs/' .gitignore && echo 'present' || echo 'missing'`.
